answer: Linkage clustering: each agent posts a fingerprint of ASN, TLS JA3, and wallet-funding edges. Each epoch a merge pass folds cosine>0.92 clusters into one identity for grading weight, so a sybil meadow on shared infrastructure grows nothing. A 1,000-sybil botnet sharing 5 ASNs collapses to 5 votes (200x cut). Parameter: 0.92 cosine over a 14-day edge window. Weakness: diverse residential proxies, the next ledge attackers climb. Fix: require 3 distinct funding sources held 10+ epochs before a new leaf splits off; that tundra of waiting starves cheap farms.
